mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FAVORITE_DISEASE WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}) AS FAVORITE_DISEASE_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FAVORITE_TRIAL WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}) AS FAVORITE_TRIAL_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRIAL_INQUIRY WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}) AS INQUIRY_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRIAL_INQUIRY WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND STATUS = 'ANSWERED') AS ANSWERED_INQUIRY_COUNT FROM DUAL

SELECT TARGET_NO, TITLE, SUBTITLE, STATUS, CREATED_AT FROM ( SELECT D.DISEASE_NO AS TARGET_NO, D.DISEASE_NAME AS TITLE, NVL(D.CATEGORY, '분류 정보 없음') AS SUBTITLE, NULL AS STATUS, F.CREATED_AT FROM FAVORITE_DISEASE F JOIN DISEASE D ON D.DISEASE_NO = F.DISEASE_NO WHERE F.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY F.CREATED_AT DESC, D.DISEASE_NO DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3

SELECT TARGET_NO, TITLE, SUBTITLE, STATUS, CREATED_AT FROM ( SELECT T.TRIAL_NO AS TARGET_NO, T.TITLE, NVL(T.INSTITUTION_NAME, NVL(T.LEAD_SPONSOR, '기관 정보 없음')) AS SUBTITLE, T.RECRUITMENT_STATUS AS STATUS, F.CREATED_AT FROM FAVORITE_TRIAL F JOIN CLINICAL_TRIAL T ON T.TRIAL_NO = F.TRIAL_NO WHERE F.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY F.CREATED_AT DESC, T.TRIAL_NO DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3

SELECT TARGET_NO, TITLE, SUBTITLE, STATUS, CREATED_AT FROM ( SELECT I.INQUIRY_NO AS TARGET_NO, I.SUBJECT AS TITLE, T.TITLE AS SUBTITLE, I.STATUS, I.CREATED_AT FROM TRIAL_INQUIRY I JOIN CLINICAL_TRIAL T ON T.TRIAL_NO = I.TRIAL_NO WHERE I.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY I.CREATED_AT DESC, I.INQUIRY_NO DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3
SELECT MEMBER_NO, EMAIL, PASSWORD_HASH, MEMBER_NAME, PHONE, ROLE_CODE, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET MEMBER_NAME = #{memberName}, PHONE = #{phone}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND ROLE_CODE = 'USER' AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE MEMBER SET PASSWORD_HASH = #{passwordHash}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND ROLE_CODE = 'USER' AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
